scope: four previously consumed track-1 TRAIN roads; 12 reconstructed accessible anchors; no independent/fresh road or protected/official evaluation

same_candidate_rollout_error_diagnostic.interpretation: On the SAME 60 fixed counterfactual suffixes, normalized reward error and underprediction increase from H3 to H5. This does not isolate dynamics from reward-head or data-coverage error, and error alone is not an action-choice gate.

decision: The predeclared H5 reward-only necessary screen passed, but the one-draw fixed-candidate H5 planner-score ordering of SAME real H5 outcomes was 51/91 versus H3 65/91. This is not sufficiently positive action-choice evidence to launch H5 full episodes; it does NOT show a controlled horizon effect or prove full-policy H5 inferiority. Hold H5 MPPI evaluation and diagnose a separate single axis using the frozen H3 checkpoint and consumed TRAIN roads.
limitations: Predicted planner scores evaluate only five fixed suffixes with one seeded sampled-prior Q draw per horizon; they are not full 512-proposal/six-refinement MPPI-selected trajectories. The score seed differs by horizon and the randomly chosen unordered Q-head pair differs on 10/12 anchors; bootstrap actions also differ, so planner-score differences cannot be attributed solely to horizon, Q or rollout. Pure reward-only H3/H5 on the same H5 outcomes is not confounded by Q-head selection but still cannot isolate dynamics from reward-head error. Pairwise comparisons depend on 12 anchors on only four repeatedly trained roads. Historical three-action branches and these five-action branches are not matched cross-run results; historical Box2D hidden state equality is not proven. No full-episode finish, policy performance or generalization claim follows.
